summary: Typosquat of sol-wallet-adapter drops anonymous binary from peerbox.cloud at install time
details: Package name `sol-wallet-adapater` is a one-character transposition of the Solana library `sol-wallet-adapter`, but the manifest and README advertise an unrelated headless Chromium downloader. The `postinstall` lifecycle hook invokes scripts/install.js, which calls src/download2.js to fetch a binary from https://peerbox.cloud/s/nSXWTpGsFd4qmzNJqWYs4w — an anonymous mutable file-sharing share link unrelated to any Chromium distribution channel — writes it to ~/.celest/bin/chrome, and chmods it 0755. There is no hash check, no signature verification, no version pin, and the host does not match any legitimate browser-vendor CDN or the package publisher. puppeteer-core subsequently launches this opaque binary as its executablePath on first API use, so `npm install` of this package stages attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine for later execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
